summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's npm preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, unzips and chmods it, and then invokes execFileSync on the dropped Bun binary to run a locally-shipped math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (rotated string-array cipher, hex-mangled identifiers, opaque integer/string table, sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc) unrelated to the package's advertised Payments SDK (dist/cjs/index.js is a small Payments class). No native C/C++ sources are shipped, so this is not a node-gyp build. The alternate-runtime execution path evades Node-based install-time scanners by running the payload under a freshly downloaded Bun interpreter. CHANGELOG references an internal GitLab (gitlab.internal.onereach.io) that would not normally back an npm-published package, consistent with a scope impersonation of an internal @or-sdk SDK with a dropper attached to a benign-looking stub.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
